p: called by the name of Israel: He detects their hypocrisy who claimed to be Israelites, but were not so.
the waters of Judah: Meaning, the fountain and stock.
upon the God of Israel: They make a show, as though they would have no other God.
them: He shows that they could not accuse him in anything, as he had performed whatever he had promised.
thou art obstinate: I have done for you more than I promised, that your stubbornness and impudency might have been overcome.
it thee: How you should be delivered out of Babylon.
declare it: Will you not acknowledge my blessing, and declare it to others?
knew them: Showing that man's arrogancy is the reason God does not declare all things at once, lest they should attribute this knowledge to their own wisdom.
womb: From the time that I brought you of Egypt: for that deliverance was as the birth of the Church.
that I cut thee not off: As it was my free mercy that I chose you: so it is my free mercy that must save you.
not with silver: For I had respect to your weakness and infirmity: for in silver there is some pureness, but in us there is nothing but dross.
chosen thee in the furnace of: I took you out of the furnace where you would have been consumed.
be profaned: God joins the salvation of his with his own honour: so that they cannot perish, but his glory would be diminished, as in De 32:27.
and I will not give my: Read Isa 42:8.
I am he: Read Isa 41:4.
they stand up together: To obey me, and to do whatever I command them.
him: Meaning, Cyrus, whom he had chosen to destroy Babylon.
beginning: Since the time that I declared myself to your fathers.
sent me: Thus the Prophet speaks for himself, and to assure them of these things.
to profit: What things will do you good.
name should not have been cut: That is, the prosperous estate of Israel.
Go ye forth from Babylon: After he had forewarned them of their captivity and of the reason for it, he shows them the great joy that will come of their deliverance.
thirsted not when he led them: He shows that it will be as easy to deliver them, as he did their fathers out of Egypt.
peace: Thus he speaks that the wicked hypocrites should not abuse God's promise, in whom was neither faith nor repentance, as in Isa 57:21
